high_level_description: The image shows a scene where Leonardo DiCaprio is leaving the Gritti Palace hotel in Venice on Thursday. The setting appears to be an outdoor area, possibly near the entrance of the hotel, as there are architectural elements like stone walls and railings visible in the background. Leonardo DiCaprio is in the center of the image, wearing a black cap, a dark blazer over a light-colored shirt, and dark pants. He is walking away from the camera, with his head slightly bowed, and seems to be in conversation or interaction with someone off-camera to his left.
